payout_quote: Earn $25 credited to your checking account when your referred friend or family member becomes an Align Credit Union member. Referred friends and family who join will enjoy $25 credited to their checking account.
steps: Be an Align Credit Union member
Refer a friend or family member using the online referral form
Have your friend or family member visit any branch location or apply online to open a new account
You earn $25 credited to your checking account when they become a member (they get $25 too)
catches: No stated cap on the number of referrals
$25 credited to your checking account upon the referee becoming a member
Friend joins via branch visit or online application after you submit the referral form
No monthly maintenance fee checking with free VISA debit card
biggest_catch: $25 per referral is on the small side — but the barrier is low: your friend just needs to become a member.
eligibility: Align Credit Union members; referred friends/family must become Align members
timing: Paid when the referred friend becomes a member
